title: Contact Midjump | Portfolio Inquiries
description: Inquire about acquiring a Midjump domain, or ask for portfolio details. Purchases are secured through Escrow.com.
heading: Portfolio Inquiries
intro: Interested in a name from the collection, or have a question about the portfolio? Send us a message and we'll get back to you.

steps.title: Share your inquiry
steps.text: Tell us which names you have in mind, along with any questions about them. Once it reaches us, we review the details and reply to you directly.

steps.title: We settle the terms together
steps.text: We confirm the terms with you and arrange the purchase the way you prefer: directly through Escrow.com, or through the domain’s listing on Atom.com.

steps.title: Protected transfer of ownership
steps.text: Your payment stays protected until the domain is registered in your name. Escrow.com and Atom.com both release funds to the seller only once the transfer is complete.
